info.name: Core V2 Audit Individual Results API
Approve Manual KYC for an individual

params.name: entityId
params.description: Unique FrankieOne identifier for an entity

items.docs:
Approve manual KYC (mKYC) for an individual as to allow them to pass all KYC workflow steps without performing eKYC. To ensure there is enough evidence for the mKYC process to be valid, the individual will need to have documents that match at least one of the following combinations:

1 Primary Photographic ID e.g. 
  - "DRIVERS_LICENSE": Driver's license.
  - "PASSPORT": Passport

2 Primary Non-Photographic IDs e.g.
  - "BIRTH_CERT": Birth certificate
  - "CITIZENSHIP": Citizenship certificate

info.name: Invalidate any Manual KYC evidences of an individual

params.name: entityId
params.description: Unique FrankieOne identifier for an entity

items.docs: Invalidate any Manual KYC evidences of an individual. This will force the entity to be verified by eKYC processes when KYC verification is next run. Only invalidate mKYC evidences if manual KYC evidences had previously been supplied for this entity.

info.name: Update the status of Duplicate process results

params.name: entityId
params.description: Unique FrankieOne identifier for an entity

items.docs:
Update the status of a set of Duplicate process results.
The request body supports batch processing of duplicate results with the following components:
- processResults: Array of UUID strings identifying specific duplicate Process Results to update - manualStatus: The resolution status for the duplicates, which can be one of:
  * FALSE_POSITIVE: When the flagged entities are determined to be different individuals (both records should be kept)
  * TRUE_POSITIVE_ACCEPT: Keep the current entity as

info.name: Get a list of process results

params.name: entityId
params.description: Unique FrankieOne identifier for an entity

params.name: profileName
params.description: The unique name of the service profile

params.name: createdAtBefore
params.description: Filter on the createdAt field, results returned are based on being before the value (inclusively)

params.name: createdAtAfter
params.description: Filter on the createdAt field, results returned are based on being after the value (inclusively)

params.name: updatedAtBefore
params.description: Filter on the updatedAt field, results returned are based on being before the value (inclusively)

params.name: updatedAtAfter
params.description: Filter on the updatedAt field, results returned are based on being before the value (inclusively)

params.name: stepNames
params.description: List of steps to include, separated by a comma.

params.name: stepTypes
params.description: A list of stepTypes the Process Result is associated with

params.name: objectTypes
params.description: List of objectTypes to filter upon

params.name: classes
params.description: List of classes to filter results with Available values : KYC, ID, IDV, AML, FRAUDLIST, FRAUDCHECK, DEVICE, MOBILE, EMAIL, LOOKUP, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, MANUAL, ORGANIZATION_PROFILE, ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP

params.name: systemStatuses
params.description:
List of systemStatus values to filter results with
Available values : VALID, EXPIRED, STALE, MARKED_INVALID, MARKED_IGNORE

params.name: states
params.description:
List of state values to filter results with
Available values : IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, TIMEOUT, ERROR

params.name: results
params.description:
List of result value that the Process Result will be filtered with
Available values : MATCH, PARTIAL_MATCH, INVALID_MATCH, NO_MATCH, CLEAR, HIT, BAD_DATA, CREATED, UPDATED, DELETED, FAIL

params.name: sortFields
params.description:
List of fields that the Process Results will be filtered with
Available values : createdAt, updatedAt

params.name: sort
params.description: Order of the sort fields will be sorted upon

params.name: page
params.description: The page number that you want to retrieve for the list query

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the number of items that will be returned as part of the request

items.docs: Get a list of process results for a given individual entity
